Employee comment (Comment, Richmond Night A, wave 2; 21 words; theme: shift handoff): "Day shift leaves before the load checklist is done, so we start blind and the 6 AM trucks go out late."
Employee comment (Comment, Richmond Night A, wave 2; 16 words; theme: shift handoff): "Handoff at six is chaos. Dispatch does not know which trailers we finished, so departures slip."
Employee comment (Comment, Richmond Night A, wave 2; 18 words; theme: shift handoff): "We never know what has been loaded when we come in. The handoff log is empty most nights."
